text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While walking past the dorms, I see
some
Umamusume gathered around
outside.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: All right, let's get this showdown started!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Whoever loses will have to clean both
dorms... so
let's win again and have them
make Ritto Dorm
spick and span!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You sure are confident. Although, it's
true this
would be our tenth consecutive
loss...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Which is why we must win this time! Our
team
needs a break!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh. Hope you don't mind going
against
Miho's risk taker again!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I'm really not in the mood to clean. So,
sorry, but
I'm putting you all on duty.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama again? We never win when
you're up.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: But this time will be different.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Our Nakayama curse and consecutive
losses are
exactly what will bring us
victory this time around!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Let's have a good match, Nakayama. ♪

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...I see. So I'm up against the Jinx
Breaker.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I was so taken by their fighting spirit
that I
decided to go and watch their
showdown.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
The rules are the same as last time. The
area is
limited to this building. Whoever
gets their
swimsuit wet loses.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You can shoot each other with water
guns, attack
each other with the shower,
or corner each other
in the pool.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
All right, Satono, Nakayama, we'll start
when I
say go.
Get ready, get set... go!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Take this! My long shot!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Piece of cake! Here's my zombie sweep
attack!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two of them continue to fight on
equal
ground for a while. But then...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I knew you wanted to break the jinx, but
I didn't
expect you'd come at me like
this.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Heh heh. I like it. This is getting heated.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa is now cornered. In
order to
counter the Jinx Breaker, she
should—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...The guts of a risk-junkie?
choice_data_list: 勝負師の根性を見せよう！
消耗戦になる前に力技でいこう！
choice_data_list_en: Let's show them a gambler's true grit!
Let's go with brute force before it becomes a war of attrition!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: So, you mean turn up the heat? I like it.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Ritto Dorm! Listen up! If I lose this,
I'll even
clean the tubs for you!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Interesting. She's making a bigger bet
even
though she's cornered.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! This is do or die, Nakayama! You
can't take
that back now!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Wasn't planning to, since I'll be winning
either
way.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa gets a sudden burst of

motivation. Shortly after...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Grrrr! That's so frustrating!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hah. That just added to the jinx. Next
time's
gonna be even more heated, I bet.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Of course it will! The stronger the jinx,
the more
fired up I get!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh. You sure know how to stay
positive.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa shows everyone the
gutsy
perseverance she gets when the
chips are down.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
What? Do you mean just brute force my
way to
victory? That seems pretty
stupid.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
But if I don't do anything, I'll be stuck in
this bad
position... Tch.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
The more cautious I become, the further
the
goddess of victory will stray from
me. Fine, I'll
end this here!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Raaaah!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ah?! You're coming at me head on?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hyah! Take my Virtual Police Shot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The competition takes a sudden turn.
And then...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... A draw. I guess the jinx is yet to
be
broken.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
See? I knew a frontal assault was a
stupid idea.
It's better than losing, at
least.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I guess this means the cleaning duties
will be split
between Miho and Ritto. A
small price to pay for
an exciting
competition.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to a bold strategy, Nakayama
Festa
avoids the worst-case scenario.
